key_decisions.original_text: devnet-8 / Platåberget testnet launch held until repricing numbers are finalized; public-facing spec should not change post-launch
devnet-8 will be named Platåberget testnet; internal NFT devnets continue in parallel for chaos testing

PFI for Hegota: EIP-8115 (batch priority fees), EIP-8116 (replace cumulative receipt fields), EIP-7807 (SSZ block hash), EIP-7819 (SETDELEGATE), EIP-7906 (transaction assertions), EIP-7668 (remove bloom filters), EIP-8200 (EVMification)
